name: tasks
description: Keep a task list for the work in hand and show it to the person. Send the WHOLE list on every call: it replaces the previous one, and an empty list clears it. Give each task a short unique id, a title, a status (pending, in_progress, done or blocked) and optionally the ids it depends on. At most 30 tasks.

tasks.description: The complete task list, in the order to show it.

id.description: Short unique id, for example t1.

title.description: What the task is, on one line.

depends_on.description: Ids of tasks that must be done first. They must exist in this list and must not form a cycle.
